items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Well there's a fella Giannis Censier, you run into Giannis Censier? ... Yeah, I saw him last time I was in y'all, he was making plenty of money.

ctx.x: You can catch him by one o'clock every day.
Well there's a fella Giannis Censier, you run into Giannis Censier?
Oh yes, I've known him. He's a nice fella.
